headline: IEA Confirms Severe Damage to Over 40 Middle East Energy Assets Amid Iran Conflict
summary: The reported widespread damage to critical Middle East energy infrastructure signifies a major escalation of the Iran conflict, directly threatening global energy supply chains and regional stability. This disruption will likely increase energy costs and shipping risks, indirectly impacting semiconductor fabs, AI infrastructure, and broader supply chain logistics reliant on stable energy markets and secure trade routes.
